name: dayOfWeek
column17: notes

Max effort: work up in 3-4 jumps of 5-10% to one clean single at RPE 9-9.5 (95-98%), no spotter, no grinding. If a variation used chains, bands or a board, drop them for the back-downs. Classic bench with a 1-2 s pause on the chest. Full ROM. Warm-up: empty bar 2 x 10, then low reps and big jumps (e.g. 60 kg x 5, 100 kg x 3, 120 kg x 1-3). Never 10 reps near working weight.
Back-down sets at ~70% of today's single, 1-2 RIR. Remove chains, bands and board.
Weighted. Narrow underhand grip, rotate every 3 weeks. Two-set method: set 1 at 1 RIR, set 2 at 0 RIR. Log total load (bodyweight + added).
Chest crusher/pec deck: full stretch or full squeeze, 0 RIR. Only a light 30 deg incline press if your shoulders recover in 48 h.
Moderate-heavy strength/mass work, 1-2 RIR, never to failure under the bar. Set 2 at 0-1 RIR.
Full stretch, controlled lowering, 0 RIR.
Rectus femoris in the stretch (hold a support). Add lengthened partials at the bottom on the last set. Leg extension is an alternative.
Dual-rope pushdown, always first for triceps to bring synovial fluid to the elbow.
Straight bar curl, strict, minimal controlled momentum. Rotate bar every 3 weeks.
Standing raise with a pause at the bottom, no spinal load.
Full range, no swinging.
Shoulder hygiene: 100 total reps (3 x 33). Add 30 s dead hangs on the bar.
